actions.reason: During training (Basic and Regex), token sequences are stored as str with one char per token (chr(id)). merge(ids, pair, idx) is then exactly str.replace(chr(p0)+chr(p1), chr(idx)) (leftmost, non-overlapping), running in C instead of a Python loop over every p0 occurrence. Pairs are char tuples internally (same dict insertion order and ties) and converted back to int pairs when saved into merges. Equivalence identical; train_ir ratio 0.729.
